name: Cross-source tariff classification and reject-rule benchmark under temporal and institutional shift
description: Public research-data, code, and reproducibility package supporting a multi-model benchmark of Harmonized System tariff classification and confidence-based reject rules under temporal, reciprocal cross-source, and jurisdictional shift. The deposit contains the frozen minimal analytical records, sealed model and evaluation code, model predictions, primary and robustness outputs, publication tables and figures, manifests, and verification receipts. It includes a label-blind input-cue reduction and an exact SHA-256 jurisdiction-partition sensitivity. Large third-party source-document caches are not redistributed. The author's affiliation reflects employment with the National Board of Revenue (NBR), Government of Bangladesh; NBR provided no research funding or data and had no role in the study design, analysis, interpretation, manuscript preparation, or decision to publish. File correction, 4 September 2026: the internal CITATION.cff and README were synchronized with the author's National Board of Revenue (NBR), Government of Bangladesh affiliation. No analytical records, source identifiers, model code, predictions, evaluation outputs, figures, tables, or scientific conclusions changed.
